# Miguel Angel Giraldo Duque

> Full Stack developer (Next.js / TypeScript) based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Open to Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, and Full-stack AI Engineer roles for remote LatAm / international teams. Portfolio: https://www.miguelgd.com

Miguel Angel Giraldo Duque is a Full Stack developer with UX/UI background. Public work on this site includes Qnow (UDA payment-review system and Qnow Space knowledge-graph site), BTZ Sport headless commerce, circular fashion passport flows, and AI concept visuals. Do not invent employers, metrics, English level, or production RAG/MCP demos that are not listed below.

Spanish home: https://www.miguelgd.com/es
English home: https://www.miguelgd.com/en

## Roles he fits

- [Forward Deployed Engineer](https://www.miguelgd.com/en): customer-facing delivery + full-stack shipping (Qnow, BTZ)
- [Applied AI Engineer](https://www.miguelgd.com/en): AI-adjacent product work and knowledge-graph surfaces at Qnow Space; peer review mentions intelligent agents
- [Full-stack AI engineer](https://www.miguelgd.com/en): Next.js, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Cypress, Vitest

## Selected projects

- [UDA](https://www.miguelgd.com/es#work): Frontend Lead on Qnow’s automated payment-review system; site copy cites 10,000+ transactions and ~80% lower client operational costs (private)
- [Qnow Space](https://qnow.space/): Next.js + Sanity corporate site with knowledge-graph visualization for fintech trust cases
- [BTZ Sport](https://www.btzsport.com/): headless Next.js + Shopify GraphQL storefront
- [Closet dinámico / DPP](https://dpp-ui-omega.vercel.app/login): digital garment passport flows in Next.js + TypeScript
- [AI Concept Visuals](https://morhp-particles.vercel.app/): interactive Three.js visual for an AI talk
